'''Asan Sandair''' is a [[Cairhien]]in soldier stationed at the [[Cairhien (city)|capital city's]] gate.

==Appearance==
Sandair is balding.

==Activities==
Asan Sandair writes the names of [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Loial]], and [[Hurin]] in his book at the gate of the city. He then informs them that they are required to return to the gate to give him the name of the inn in which they stay.{{ref/book|2|25}}
